names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 martie, «Sfântul Ierarh Avdas».

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 31 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свештеномученик Авда, епископ града Сузе“, with the rank word Свештеномученик left off and with the see епископ града Сузе left off as well, this folder keeping the see in `office`. The heading gives no epithet beyond the see, so the bare forename is what the source gives.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru: “Мч. Авдия (Авида) в Персии (V)”.

feast.note: This calendar keeps him a second time on 31 марта ст. ст., where the Romanian, the Greek and the Serbian all keep him and where the line pairs him with Benjamin the deacon: «Сщмчч. @5[Авды], еп. Персидского, и Вениамина диакона (418-424).» One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it; the day was read on 8 October 2026 and nothing else on this row was touched. THE DAY PAGE MANGLES HIS NAME: it prints the forename inside the markup `@5[Авды]` instead of linking it, so the page carries a name link for the deacon and NONE for him, and `ru-namesweep.mjs` returned no Abda folder for the heading at all. The folder was found through the menologion-day list instead. No `ru` name form was read off that day in consequence: the two this folder holds, «Авдий» and «Авид», come from the 5 сентября line, which is this row’s own source.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 сентября ст. ст. — «Мч. Авдия (Авида) в Персии (V)»
doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 31 martie — «Sfântul Ierarh Avdas»
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 5 Σεπτεμβρίου — «Άγιος Αβδαίος επίσκοπος Περσίας»
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 13.04.2026 (31. март ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Авда, епископ града Сузе“

attestations.note: The day's third entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and the same man: a bishop in Persia beheaded for Christ by the king Izdegerd, with his deacon Benjamin beside him. **The heading gives the see this folder does not have**, епископ града Сузе, bishop of the city of Susa, where `office` reads «Bishop in Persia» from the other calendars; the see was recorded here and in the life and `office` was **not** rewritten, because changing a sourced field on one calendar's word is the author's call and not a reader's. The entry dates the beheading 418, which falls inside the fifth century this folder holds from days.pravoslavie.ru and is narrower than it, so **the interval was not narrowed**; the year is recorded here instead. It is also the whole of what this entry says of him — no birthplace, no trial, no manner of death beyond the sword, and nothing of the nine leading Christians saint.gr puts to death with him, who are `nine-martyrs-with-abda` and whom this page does not mention at all. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. The stored form Авда folds with nothing: no other folder in the corpus holds a Serbian form of this spelling.
